import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import torch

torch.set_num_threads(1)
root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');path=Path('/workspace/work/harbichess/ufuk-validation-panel.pt')
started=time.perf_counter();h=hashlib.sha256()
with path.open('rb') as stream:
 for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
assert h.hexdigest()=='33fbb59df6b400819ccacc4393c660c8ff2de1c5e8a6328736ef962c8bdb7039'
cache=torch.load(path,weights_only=True);result={}
for key,metric in [('policies','policy_ce'),('wdl','value_ce')]:
 entropies=[];errors=[];support=[]
 for start in range(0,20000,256):
  p=cache['tensors'][key][start:start+256].to(torch.float64)
  assert torch.isfinite(p).all() and (p>=0).all()
  errors.extend((p.sum(1)-1).abs().tolist());support.extend((p>0).sum(1).tolist())
  entropies.extend(torch.where(p>0,p*p.log(),0).neg().sum(1).tolist())
 assert len(entropies)==20000 and max(errors)<1e-6
 mean=sum(entropies)/len(entropies);ce=cache['baseline_metrics'][metric];ordered=sorted(entropies)
 result[key]={'rows':len(entropies),'mean_target_entropy_nats':mean,'observed_native_ce':ce,'excess_ce_over_entropy':ce-mean,'max_theoretical_ce_improvement':ce-mean,'mean_positive_support':sum(support)/len(support),'entropy_min_median_max':[ordered[0],ordered[len(ordered)//2],ordered[-1]],'max_probability_sum_error':max(errors),'entropy_by_row':entropies}
 assert ce>=mean-1e-6
report={'schema':1,'cache_sha256':h.hexdigest(),'precision':'Target entropy float64; historical observed CE FP32;1e-6 normalization/sign tolerance.','panels':result,'policy_temperature_cp':100,'reference_semantics':'Native score_softmax over coherent MultiPV reference scores, not observed weak-policy terminal outcomes.','wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'scope':'Intrinsic target entropy/CE-H interpretation only, not strength or architecture promotion.'}
assert report['wall_seconds']<=300
destination=root/'artifacts/ufuk-target-entropy-20261003.json';assert not destination.exists();destination.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({**{k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='panels'},'panels':{k:{a:b for a,b in v.items() if a!='entropy_by_row'} for k,v in result.items()}}))
